title: The Vine and the Branches
description: Jesus says: 'I am the true vine, you are the branches.' The Father is the vinedresser who prunes the branches so that they bear more fruit. Whoever abides in Jesus bears much fruit, and he commands his disciples to love one another as he has loved them.
